camel_example: aliyun ons OnsTopicList --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key CartService --InstanceId MQ_INST_1880770869020000_BXSuW61e --Tag.1.Value ServiceA --Topic test
description_en: Queries information about all topics in your account
description_zh: 查询账号下所有Topic的信息列表
kebab_example: aliyun ons ons-topic-list --topic test --instance-id MQ_INST_1880770869020000_BXSuW61e --tag Value=ServiceA Key=CartService --region cn-hangzhou
name: OnsTopicList

parameters.help_en: Specify the topic to query. If you leave this parameter empty, all topics are queried
parameters.help_zh: 查询指定Topic时设置，若不输入，则查询所有Topic
parameters.name: topic

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance that contains the topics you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 需获取的Topic信息列表所对应的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the topic. You must specify the Key and Value parameters at the same time, or leave them both empty. If you specify both parameters, this operation queries topics that have the specified tag. If you leave both parameters empty, this operation queries all topics.

If you specify this parameter, its value cannot be an empty string.

The value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
Topic的标签键。Key和Value值必须同时输入或同时不输入。若同时输入表示根据Tag过滤符合条件的Topic，若不输入表示查询所有Topic。

如果输入该值，则取值不允许为空字符串。
最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the topic. You must specify the Key and Value parameters at the same time, or leave them both empty. If you specify both parameters, this operation queries topics that have the specified tag. If you leave both parameters empty, this operation queries all topics.

If you specify this parameter, its value can be an empty string.

The value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
Topic的标签值。Key和Value值必须同时输入或同时不输入。若同时输入表示根据Tag过滤符合条件的Topic，若不输入表示查询所有Topic。

如果输入该值，取值允许为空字符串。
最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags that are attached to the topic. The list can contain a maximum of 20 elements
parameters.help_zh: Topic所绑定的标签列表。列表元素个数不得超过 20
parameters.name: tag

PublishInfoDo.description_en: The list of topics in the specified instance
PublishInfoDo.description_zh: 返回指定实例的Topic信息列表

items.description_en: The data structure of the returned topic

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the topic was created

IndependentNaming.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance that contains the topic has a namespace. Valid values:

true: The instance has an independent namespace. The resource name must be unique within the instance. The resource name can be the same as a resource name in another instance.

false: The instance does not have an independent namespace. The resource name must be globally unique within and across all instances
IndependentNaming.description_zh:
Topic所在实例是否有命名空间。取值说明如下：

true：拥有独立命名空间，资源命名确保实例内唯一，跨实例之间可重名。
false：无独立命名空间，实例内或者跨实例之间，资源命名必须全局唯一

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the instance that contains the topic

MessageType.description_en:
The message type. Valid values:

0: Normal message

1: Partitionally ordered message

2: Globally ordered message

4: Transactional message

5: Scheduled and delayed message
MessageType.description_zh:
消息类型。取值说明如下：

0：普通消息
1：分区顺序消息
2：全局顺序消息
4：事务消息
5：定时/延时消息

Owner.description_en: The ID of the topic owner. This is the ID of an Alibaba Cloud account
Owner.description_zh: Topic所有者编号，为阿里云的账号ID

Relation.description_en:
The relation ID. Valid values:

1: The owner of the topic.

2: The account can publish messages to the topic.

4: The account can subscribe to the topic.

6: The account can publish messages to and subscribe to the topic
Relation.description_zh:
所有关系编号。取值说明如下：

1：持有者
2：可以发布
4：可以订阅
6：可以发布和订阅

RelationName.description_en: The relation name. Valid values are Owner, Subscribable, Publishable, and Publishable and Subscribable
RelationName.description_zh: 所有关系名称，例如持有者、可订阅、可发布和可发布订阅

ServiceStatus.description_en:
The status of the asynchronous topic creation. Valid values:

0: Creating.

1: In service
ServiceStatus.description_zh:
Topic异步创建的状态。取值说明如下：
0：创建中。
1：服务中

Tag.description_en: The tags that are attached to the topic

items.description_en: The definition of the tag structure

RequestId.description_en: This is a common parameter. Each request has a unique ID. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
